TimeRangePickerRoot.description: Holds the range and shares it, with the bounds, locale and the rest, with the two sides. A `role="group"`, named by its `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or an enclosing FieldLabel. With a name, or inside a FieldRoot, it renders the two hidden `<input type="time">`s that submit the range and that Field validates.

props.defaultValue: The range at first, when it isn't controlled. A form reset puts it back.
props.locale: The locale of both fields and their popups.
props.granularity: The smallest unit of both times: `"hour"`, `"minute"` or `"second"`.
props.hourCycle: `12` or `24` overrides the locale's hour cycle.
props.secondStep: Seconds between the second columns' options.
props.placeholderValue: What a choice starts from on a side with no time yet.
props.disabled: Whether neither side can be changed. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot.
props.readOnly: Whether the fields can be focused but not changed; the triggers are disabled.
props.required: Whether both times are needed for the form to be valid.
props.form: The id of a `<form>` the hidden inputs belong to.
props.incompleteMessage: The validation message while a side is partly filled.
props.rangeOrderMessage: The validation message for an end before the start (unless `allowOvernight`).

dataAttributes.data-invalid: Present when the end is before the start (and `allowOvernight` is off), a side is outside `min`/`max` or partly filled, or the FieldRoot around it is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the range is disabled.

defaults.rangeOrderMessage: "The end time is before the start time."

TimeRangePickerStart.description: The start: a TimePickerRoot for the range's start, bounded above by the end unless `allowOvernight`. Inside it go the Time Picker's parts (TimePickerField, TimePickerTrigger, TimePickerPopup and its columns). Its field submits `<name>-start`.

props.defaultOpen: Whether this side's popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called after this side's popup opens or closes.

TimeRangePickerEnd.description: The end: a TimePickerRoot for the range's end, bounded below by the start unless `allowOvernight`, so its popup disables what would put it earlier. Its field submits `<name>-end`.

props.defaultOpen: Whether this side's popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called after this side's popup opens or closes.

TimeRangePickerSeparator.description: A span between the two sides, hidden from assistive technology (each field has its own name). Its text is yours: "–", "to".
